DEWPOINT.NAME: Dewpoint calculator
DEWPOINT.DESCRIPTION: Dew point from temperature and relative humidity (Magnus formula)

O.NAME: Offset (K)
O.DESCRIPTION: Added to the calculated dew point

HEATING_CURVE.NAME: Heating curve
HEATING_CURVE.DESCRIPTION: Weather compensated flow temperature from room setpoint and outdoor temperature

OUT.IV: 1 while the curve is limited by minFt / maxFt

S.NAME: Slope
S.DESCRIPTION: Slope of the heating curve (typ. 0.2 underfloor .. 1.6 radiators)

MINFT.NAME: Minimum flow temperature (°C)
MINFT.DESCRIPTION: Lower limit of the flow temperature

MAXFT.NAME: Maximum flow temperature (°C)
MAXFT.DESCRIPTION: Upper limit of the flow temperature

TWO_POSITION.NAME: 2-position controller
TWO_POSITION.DESCRIPTION: Switches an output on and off around a setpoint with hysteresis

HYS.NAME: Hysteresis
HYS.DESCRIPTION: Total width of the switching band around the setpoint

INV.NAME: Inverted
INV.DESCRIPTION: Off: on below the setpoint (heating). On: on above the setpoint (cooling)

THREE_POSITION.NAME: 3-position controller
THREE_POSITION.DESCRIPTION: Two outputs with opposite effect: O1 below setpoint 1, O2 above setpoint 2

HYS.NAME: Hysteresis
HYS.DESCRIPTION: An output switches off this far back inside the band (0 = at the setpoint)

MIXING_VALVE.NAME: Mixing valve controller
MIXING_VALVE.DESCRIPTION: PI control of a mixing valve: 0-100 % or open/close outputs

IN.OFF: 1 = controller off, valve per Off mode
IN.DISPC: 1 = keep the current target temperature (e.g. child lock)

OUT.ERROR: 1 when target and current temperature are more than 5 K apart for over 10 minutes

TD.NAME: Travel time (s)
TD.DESCRIPTION: Time of the valve from closed to open

ST.NAME: Sampling time (s)
ST.DESCRIPTION: The controller calculates a new position at this interval

KP.NAME: Gain Kp (% per K)
KP.DESCRIPTION: Proportional part of the PI controller

KI.NAME: Integral Ki (% per K and s)
KI.DESCRIPTION: Integral part of the PI controller

MODE.NAME: Mode
MODE.DESCRIPTION: Inverted for cooling: the valve opens while the temperature is too high

MINP.NAME: Minimum position (%)
MINP.DESCRIPTION: Lowest valve position of the controller

MAXP.NAME: Maximum position (%)
MAXP.DESCRIPTION: Highest valve position of the controller

ROOM_CONTROLLER.NAME: Intelligent room controller
ROOM_CONTROLLER.DESCRIPTION: Keeps the room temperature, switches between heating and cooling, comfort/eco/building protection

IN.MODE: -1 off, 0 auto, 1 auto heating only, 2 auto cooling only, 3 fixed setpoint, 4 fixed heating only, 5 fixed cooling only
IN.TT: Target temperature in the fixed setpoint modes (°C)
IN.COMFORT: Comfort: starts on the rising edge, extended by Cet after the falling edge
IN.ECO: Eco: starts on the rising edge, extended by EBpet after the falling edge
IN.BP: Building protection: starts on the rising edge, extended by EBpet
IN.P: Presence: comfort while on and Pet after
IN.OFF: Rising edge cancels the timers, 1 = locked (all outputs 0)
IN.TO: Outdoor temperature (°C), used for open windows
IN.TCOMF: Comfort heating temperature from the visualization (°C), comfort cooling keeps its distance
IN.SM: Source mode of a central source (Rm): 1 heating, 2 cooling, 3 none, 0 / unlinked = any
IN.EH: Surplus heating energy: heating setpoint + Texc
IN.EC: Surplus cooling energy: cooling setpoint - Texc

OUT.DEMAND: Demand for a central source (%): + heating, - cooling
OUT.ERROR: 1 below frost or above heat protection temperature
OUT.BOOST: 1 while more than 1.5 K away from the target
OUT.OS: Temperature mode: -1 off, 0 eco, 1 comfort, 2 building protection, 3 fixed setpoint

TEH.NAME: Eco heating (K)
TEH.DESCRIPTION: Eco heating = comfort heating - this value

TEC.NAME: Eco cooling (K)
TEC.DESCRIPTION: Eco cooling = comfort cooling + this value

TFP.NAME: Frost protection (°C)
TFP.DESCRIPTION: Building protection heats up to this temperature

THP.NAME: Heat protection (°C)
THP.DESCRIPTION: Building protection cools down to this temperature

TSH.NAME: Shading while heating (°C)
TSH.DESCRIPTION: Shading demand above this temperature while heating

TSC.NAME: Shading while cooling (°C)
TSC.DESCRIPTION: Shading demand above this temperature while cooling

TD.NAME: Allowed deviation (K)
TD.DESCRIPTION: Fixed setpoint modes: cooling starts this far above the target

TEXC.NAME: Surplus offset (K)
TEXC.DESCRIPTION: Setpoint shift while surplus energy is signalled (Eh / Ec)

CET.NAME: Comfort extension (s)
CET.DESCRIPTION: Comfort continues this long after C falls

EBPET.NAME: Eco / building protection extension (s)
EBPET.DESCRIPTION: Continues this long after E / Bp fall, 0 = until the next override

PET.NAME: Presence extension (s)
PET.DESCRIPTION: Comfort continues this long after presence ends

DDWC.NAME: Window delay (s)
DDWC.DESCRIPTION: Building protection starts this long after a window opened

PB.NAME: Proportional band (K)
PB.DESCRIPTION: Deviation that opens the valve to 100 %

KI.NAME: Integral (% per K and s)
KI.DESCRIPTION: Integral part of the valve controller

DEFAULT.NAME: Default mode
DEFAULT.DESCRIPTION: Temperature mode without C / E / Bp / presence (this block has no schedule, link a timer to C or E)

HEATING_COOLING.NAME: Heating and cooling controller
HEATING_COOLING.DESCRIPTION: Central heating/cooling source, decides heating or cooling from the room demands

IN.B: Boost: stage 2 at once, plus additional heating while heating
IN.EH: Surplus heating energy, forwarded while heating
IN.EC: Surplus cooling energy, forwarded while cooling
IN.MH: Manual heating: heats regardless of the rooms
IN.SERVICE: Service mode: 0 normal, 1 heating, 2 cooling, 3 off

OUT.RM: Source mode for the room controllers (Sm): 1 heating, 2 cooling, 3 none
OUT.EHOUT: Surplus heating for the room controllers
OUT.ECOUT: Surplus cooling for the room controllers

MINHR.NAME: Minimum runtime (min)
MINHR.DESCRIPTION: Heating/cooling runs at least this long

SOT.NAME: Switch-on threshold (%)
SOT.DESCRIPTION: Average room demand needed to start

VD.NAME: Valve delay (s)
VD.DESCRIPTION: Travel time of the switching valve, H/C follow after it

FOD.NAME: Fan overrun (s)
FOD.DESCRIPTION: The fan keeps running after heating/cooling

OTM.NAME: Outdoor temperature mode
OTM.DESCRIPTION: Which outdoor temperature is compared with the heating and cooling limits. The 48 h average is known after 24 h, until then the current value is used.

LIMH.NAME: Heating limit (°C)
LIMH.DESCRIPTION: Above this outdoor temperature heating does not start.

LIMC.NAME: Cooling limit (°C)
LIMC.DESCRIPTION: Below this outdoor temperature cooling does not start.

HVAC.NAME: HVAC controller
HVAC.DESCRIPTION: Air based heating/cooling system (furnace, AC, heat pump with backup) fed by room demands

IN.MODE: 0 off, 1 auto, 2 heating only, 3 cooling only (unlinked = auto)
IN.EMH: Emergency heat instead of the heat pump
IN.EH: Surplus heating energy, forwarded while heating
IN.EC: Surplus cooling energy, forwarded while cooling

OUT.OB: Reversing valve (on for cooling, DirV inverts)
OUT.RM: Source mode for the room controllers (Sm): 1 heating, 2 cooling, 3 none
OUT.EHOUT: Surplus heating for the room controllers
OUT.ECOUT: Surplus cooling for the room controllers

MINO.NAME: Minimum off time (s)
MINO.DESCRIPTION: Heating/cooling stays off at least this long

SOT.NAME: Switch-on threshold (%)
SOT.DESCRIPTION: Average room demand needed to start

FOT.NAME: Fan overrun (s)
FOT.DESCRIPTION: The fan keeps running after heating/cooling

S2D.NAME: Stage 2 demand (%)
S2D.DESCRIPTION: Stage 2 starts when one room demands this much

MIOC.NAME: Minimum outdoor temperature cooling (°C)
MIOC.DESCRIPTION: Below it only heating is allowed

MAOH.NAME: Maximum outdoor temperature heating (°C)
MAOH.DESCRIPTION: Above it only cooling is allowed

PMIC.NAME: Protection minimum cooling (°C)
PMIC.DESCRIPTION: The compressor does not cool below this outdoor temperature

PMIH.NAME: Protection minimum heating (°C)
PMIH.DESCRIPTION: Heat pump with fossil backup: below it the furnace heats

PMAH.NAME: Protection maximum heating (°C)
PMAH.DESCRIPTION: The heat pump does not heat above this outdoor temperature

HS.NAME: Humidity setpoint (%)
HS.DESCRIPTION: The humidifier runs below it while heating, until 2 % above

DIRV.NAME: Invert reversing valve
DIRV.DESCRIPTION: O/B on for heating instead of cooling

OTM.NAME: Outdoor temperature mode
OTM.DESCRIPTION: Which outdoor temperature is compared with the limits

FLOW_TEMPERATURE.NAME: Flow temperature calculator
FLOW_TEMPERATURE.DESCRIPTION: Flow temperature of a mixing circuit from the heating curve and the room demands

IN.ST: Stop: pump off, minimum (heating) / maximum (cooling) flow
IN.TB: Buffer temperature (°C), the pump waits until it reaches AQb

OUT.AQT: Target temperature of the room that sets the flow (°C)
OUT.AQI: Flow increase (heating) / decrease (cooling) by the rooms (K)
OUT.QE: 1 while the outdoor temperature is missing

MIN.NAME: Minimum flow temperature (°C)
MIN.DESCRIPTION: Lower limit, also the flow without heating demand

MAX.NAME: Maximum flow temperature (°C)
MAX.DESCRIPTION: Upper limit, also the flow without cooling demand

B.NAME: Buffer offset (K)
B.DESCRIPTION: Buffer setpoint above (heating) / below (cooling) the flow

STR.NAME: Switch-on threshold (%)
STR.DESCRIPTION: The pump runs once a room valve is open this far

G.NAME: Gain
G.DESCRIPTION: Weight of the room deviation on the room target

I.NAME: Heat-up increase (K)
I.DESCRIPTION: Added to the room target while it is more than 1.5 K away

AC_UNIT.NAME: AC unit controller
AC_UNIT.DESCRIPTION: Air conditioning indoor unit: on/off, mode, fan, target temperature, pauses

IN.FAN: Fan speed 0 off, 1 auto, 2 silent .. 7 very high
IN.ADIR: Airflow direction 1 auto, 2-6 position, 7 swing, 8 no swing
IN.DWC: Window / door contact, pauses while open
IN.PT: Pause timer: pauses for Ptd seconds
IN.HCM: Mode of a room controller (HCm): runs only on its demand

OUT.DEMAND: Demand for the AC central (K): + heating, - cooling

AC_CENTRAL.NAME: AC central controller
AC_CENTRAL.DESCRIPTION: Outdoor unit of a multi split system, pauses indoor units with the other mode

IN.D1: Demand 1 of an AC unit (D, K)
IN.D2: Demand 2 of an AC unit (D, K)
IN.D3: Demand 3 of an AC unit (D, K)
IN.D4: Demand 4 of an AC unit (D, K)
IN.D5: Demand 5 of an AC unit (D, K)
IN.D6: Demand 6 of an AC unit (D, K)
IN.D7: Demand 7 of an AC unit (D, K)
IN.D8: Demand 8 of an AC unit (D, K)

LIMH.NAME: Heating limit (°C)
LIMH.DESCRIPTION: Above this outdoor temperature heating does not start.

LIMC.NAME: Cooling limit (°C)
LIMC.DESCRIPTION: Below this outdoor temperature cooling does not start.

OTM.NAME: Outdoor temperature mode
OTM.DESCRIPTION: Which outdoor temperature is compared with the heating and cooling limits. The 48 h average is known after 24 h, until then the current value is used.

MINRT.NAME: Minimum runtime (min)
MINRT.DESCRIPTION: A mode is kept at least this long

FAN_COIL_CENTRAL.NAME: Fan coil central controller
FAN_COIL_CENTRAL.DESCRIPTION: Central heating/cooling source of fan coil units, 2- or 4-pipe

IN.HAC: Heating confirmed by the source (unlinked = yes)
IN.CAC: Cooling confirmed by the source (unlinked = yes)
IN.D1: Demand 1 of a fan coil unit (D, %)
IN.D2: Demand 2 of a fan coil unit (D, %)
IN.D3: Demand 3 of a fan coil unit (D, %)
IN.D4: Demand 4 of a fan coil unit (D, %)
IN.D5: Demand 5 of a fan coil unit (D, %)
IN.D6: Demand 6 of a fan coil unit (D, %)
IN.D7: Demand 7 of a fan coil unit (D, %)
IN.D8: Demand 8 of a fan coil unit (D, %)

OUT.AVMODE: Allowed modes: 0 none, 1 heating, 2 cooling, 3 both

PIPES.NAME: Pipe system
PIPES.DESCRIPTION: 4-pipe heats and cools independently, 2-pipe changes over

SOTH.NAME: Switch-on threshold heating (%)
SOTH.DESCRIPTION: Average unit demand needed to heat

SOTC.NAME: Switch-on threshold cooling (%)
SOTC.DESCRIPTION: Average unit demand needed to cool

MINHRT.NAME: Minimum heating runtime (min)
MINHRT.DESCRIPTION: Heating runs at least this long

MINCRT.NAME: Minimum cooling runtime (min)
MINCRT.DESCRIPTION: Cooling runs at least this long

OTM.NAME: Outdoor temperature mode
OTM.DESCRIPTION: Which outdoor temperature is compared with the heating and cooling limits. The 48 h average is known after 24 h, until then the current value is used.

LIMH.NAME: Heating limit (°C)
LIMH.DESCRIPTION: Above this outdoor temperature heating does not start.

LIMC.NAME: Cooling limit (°C)
LIMC.DESCRIPTION: Below this outdoor temperature cooling does not start.

VD.NAME: Valve delay (s)
VD.DESCRIPTION: Travel time of the switching valve (2-pipe)

FAN_COIL_UNIT.NAME: Fan coil unit controller
FAN_COIL_UNIT.DESCRIPTION: Fan coil unit: fan speed by PI controller, heating/cooling valves on demand

IN.HA: Heating available (unlinked = yes), link to Uh of the central
IN.CA: Cooling available (unlinked = yes), link to Uc of the central
IN.DWC: Window / door contact, everything off while open
IN.SM: Silent mode: fan limited to the silent speed
IN.PT: Pause timer: off for Ptd seconds
IN.HCM: Mode of a room controller (HCm): 1 heating, -1 cooling

OUT.MODEOUT: Current mode: 0 off, 1 auto, 2 heating, 3 cooling, 4 ventilation
OUT.S: On while a valve is open or the fan runs
OUT.DEMAND: Demand for the fan coil central (%): + heating, - cooling

FMAX.NAME: Maximum fan speed in auto (%)
FMAX.DESCRIPTION: Upper limit of the automatic fan

FKP.NAME: Fan gain Kp (% per K)
FKP.DESCRIPTION: Proportional part of the temperature fan controller

FKI.NAME: Fan integral Ki (% per K and s)
FKI.DESCRIPTION: Integral part of the temperature fan controller

FST.NAME: Fan sampling time (s)
FST.DESCRIPTION: Interval of the temperature fan controller

STEPS.NAME: Fan speed steps
STEPS.DESCRIPTION: Number of steps of FanS, 0 = no FanS

FAN_COIL_FRESH_AIR.NAME: Fan coil fresh air unit controller
FAN_COIL_FRESH_AIR.DESCRIPTION: Fan coil unit with fresh air: fan and valves by temperature and CO2

IN.HA: Heating available (unlinked = yes), link to Uh of the central
IN.CA: Cooling available (unlinked = yes), link to Uc of the central
IN.DWC: Window / door contact, everything off while open
IN.SM: Silent mode: fan limited to the silent speed
IN.PT: Pause timer: off for Ptd seconds
IN.HCM: Mode of a room controller (HCm): 1 heating, -1 cooling

OUT.MODEOUT: Current mode: 0 off, 1 auto, 2 heating, 3 cooling, 4 ventilation
OUT.S: On while a valve is open or the fan runs
OUT.DEMAND: Demand for the fan coil central (%): + heating, - cooling

FMAX.NAME: Maximum fan speed in auto (%)
FMAX.DESCRIPTION: Upper limit of the automatic fan

FKP.NAME: Fan gain Kp (% per K)
FKP.DESCRIPTION: Proportional part of the temperature fan controller

FKI.NAME: Fan integral Ki (% per K and s)
FKI.DESCRIPTION: Integral part of the temperature fan controller

FST.NAME: Fan sampling time (s)
FST.DESCRIPTION: Interval of the temperature fan controller

STEPS.NAME: Fan speed steps
STEPS.DESCRIPTION: Number of steps of FanS, 0 = no FanS

CO2T.NAME: CO2 target (ppm)
CO2T.DESCRIPTION: Above it the air quality counts as bad

CKP.NAME: CO2 fan gain Kp (% per 100 ppm)
CKP.DESCRIPTION: Proportional part of the CO2 fan controller

CKI.NAME: CO2 fan integral Ki (% per 100 ppm and s)
CKI.DESCRIPTION: Integral part of the CO2 fan controller

CST.NAME: CO2 sampling time (s)
CST.DESCRIPTION: Interval of the CO2 fan controller

VKP.NAME: Valve gain Kp (% per K)
VKP.DESCRIPTION: Proportional part of the valve controller with bad air

VKI.NAME: Valve integral Ki (% per K and s)
VKI.DESCRIPTION: Integral part of the valve controller with bad air
